qe: The survey officer visited Nawadeh, where a Jain temple stands on a small square terrace in the middle of a tank. What did the two carved stones in the temple bear on their top?
qh: सर्वेक्षण में नवादा पहुँचने पर वहाँ तालाब के बीच छोटे वर्गाकार चबूतरे पर एक जैन मंदिर मिला। मंदिर के दो तराशे हुए पत्थरों के ऊपर क्या बना हुआ था?
oe: Resemblances of the human feet surrounded by short inscriptions
A carved lotus with a bull
The figure of a seated Buddha
The figure of a Jain Tirthankara
oh: मानवीय चरणों के चिह्न, जिनके चारों ओर छोटे अभिलेख खुदे थे
e: Gaya kshetra ke sarvekshan me Nawadeh naam ke ek chhote bazaar gaon ka zikr milta hai. Wahan ek talaab hai, jo purab-pashchim lambai me phaila hua tha tatha kai tarah ke paudhon se bhara pada tha. Talaab ke beech ek chhote vargakar chabutre par ek mandir bana hua tha; yah ek chhota magar suhavana bhawan tha, jiske upar ek gumbad tha tatha wahan pahunchne ke liye ek purani sadak tatha eenton ka bana saral pat tha. Mandir achhi halat me tha, isliye andaza lagaya gaya ki sau saal purana hote hue bhi yah kai baar theek kiya gaya hoga. Mandir ke andar do patthar the, jinpar bahut tarashai ki gayi thi tatha jo purane lagte the; inme se ek patthar to chhura hua tha. In pattharon ke upar manushya ke pairon ke chinh bane the tatha unke charon or chhote-chhote abhilekh khude the. Aashcharya ki baat yah thi ki us talaab ke aas-paas kisi purane Bauddh ya Jain vihar ka koi nishan nahi mila tatha wahan ek bhi Jain nahi rahta tha. Exam point: Nawadeh ke talaab ke beech chhote chabutre par ek gumbad wala mandir tha; uske do tarashe pattharon ke upar manav pairon ke chinh tatha unke charon or chhote abhilekh khude the tatha unme se ek patthar chhura hua tha; us kshetra me Jain ya Bauddh vihar ka koi nishan nahi mila.

qe: The surveyor saw under a tree at a village named Karim a broken image of which deity, which the people of the vicinity had renamed and were worshipping?
qh: करीम नाम के गाँव में एक पेड़ के नीचे सर्वेक्षक ने किस देवता की टूटी प्रतिमा देखी, जिसका नाम बदलकर आसपास के लोग उसकी पूजा कर रहे थे?
e: Gaya kshetra me sarvekshan karte hue ek gaon Karim me, ek ped ke niche, kuch tooti-phooti murtiyan dekhi gayin. Inme ek murti Buddha ki thi, jo unki sabse aam mudra yaani posture me bani hui thi. Us daur me Bauddh dharm ka prabhav khatm ho chuka tha tatha logon ko is baat ki jaankari nahi thi ki yah murti kis devta ki hai; isliye gaon ke aas-paas ke logon ne us murti ka naam badal kar uski puja shuru kar di thi. Sarvekshan afsar ko bataya gaya ki jile ke is bhag me aisi murtiyan bahut aam hain tatha unhe Rajgriha se la kar yahan sthapit kiya gaya tha. Aise nishaan dikhate hain ki prachin Bauddh sthalon ki murtiyan samay ke saath lok-devtaon me badal gayin tatha gaon ki puja ka hissa ban gayin. Exam point: Karim gaon me ped ke niche Buddha ki ek tooti hui murti mili, jise sthanik logon ne naya naam de kar puja shuru kar di thi; bataya gaya ki aisi murtiyan is kshetra me aam hain tatha unhe Rajgriha se la kar yahan rakha gaya tha.

qe: On his way to Nawadeh the surveyor noted a ruined old mud fort near which was a small neat mosque. Who was the fort said to have belonged to?
qh: नवादा जाते समय सर्वेक्षक ने जर्जर पुरानी मिट्टी की गढ़ी देखी, जिसके पास सुंदर सी एक मस्जिद थी। वह गढ़ी किसकी बताई जाती थी?
e: Gaya kshetra ke sarvekshan me ek jagah se doosri jagah jate hue raaste me kai purane nishan dikhe. Nawadeh ki or jate samay ek purani mitti ki gadhi mili, jo us samay jarda-jarda hokar toot chuki thi; yah gadhi Kamdar Khan ki batai jaati thi tatha uske paas hi ek chhota magar sundar tareeke se bana hua masjid tha. Itne saalon me gadhi dhal gayi, lekin masjid abhi bhi khadi thi; isse andaza milta hai ki us daur me aisi mitti ki gadhiyan sabse pehle toot-ti thin, jabki pakki eenton se bane dharmik bhawan lambe samay tak tike rahte the. Isi safar me jile me aise gumbad-dar-gumbad eenton ki dhair bhi milti rahi, jo purane mandiron tatha mathon ke nishaan the. Exam point: Nawadeh ki or jate hue raaste me Kamdar Khan ki purani mitti ki gadhi mili, jo jarda-jarda hokar toot chuki thi; uske paas ek chhota sundar masjid tha; aise sthal dikhate hain ki mitti ke banaye bhawan jaldi tootte the tatha eenton ke bane bhawan der tak khade rahte the.

qe: The surveyor came to a ruined mud fort on a fine rising ground, and a quarter of a mile beyond it found a small heap of bricks with what upon it?
qh: सर्वेक्षक एक ऊँची अच्छी भूमि पर बनी जर्जर मिट्टी की गढ़ी तक पहुँचा, तथा उससे पौन मील आगे ईंटों का छोटा ढेर मिला, जिस पर क्या रखा था?
e: Gaya kshetra ke is safar me ek sthal par ek purani mitti ki gadhi mili, jo ek unchi tatha aankhon ko bhane wali zameen par bani hui thi; wahan se aas-paas ka poora drishya dikhta tha. Is gadhi me ek bada mitti ka kila tha tatha kaha jaata tha ki yah bhi puraane zamindaron ki rahi hogi. Gadhi se lagbhag paun mile aage eenton ka ek chhota dher mila, jispar do shivling rakhe hue the; iske aage ek talaab ke paar eenton ka ek aur bada dher bhi mila. In nishanon ko dekh kar sarvekshan afsar ne yah andaza lagaya ki Musalmano ke aane se pehle yah sthal Hindu samaj me koi mahatvapurn jagah rahi hogi, kyunki shivling tatha eenton ke dher aise sthalon ke purane nishaan hote hain. Is tarah purane tille tatha eenton ke dher aise sthalon ke itihas ke gawah ban jaate hain. Exam point: ek unchi zameen par purani mitti ki gadhi mili tatha uske paas eenton ke dher milte the; gadhi se paun mile aage eenton ke chhote dher par do shivling tatha aage bade dher ke nishan mile; sarvekshan afsar ne isse yah andaza lagaya ki Musalman rajaon se pehle yah sthal Hindu samaj me mahatvapurn tha.

qe: At Morera, about five miles beyond the Sakri river, the surveyor saw a considerable brick building which was the residence of some Sannyasis. What was it called?
qh: साकरी नदी से लगभग पाँच मील आगे मोरेरा में सर्वेक्षक ने ईंटों की एक बड़ी इमारत देखी, जो कुछ संन्यासियों का निवास थी। उसे क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Gaya kshetra me sarvekshan ke dauran ek sthal Morera par eenton ki ek badi imarat mili. Yah imarat kuch sanyasiyon ka nivas thi tatha usay Math kaha jaata tha. In sanyasiyon ke paas us eenton ki imarat ke alava kai bade mitti ke gharon ka samooh bhi tha; is tarah dikhta hai ki us daur me math tatha akhade keval ek imarat nahi hote the, balki ek chhote gaon jaise aawas ban jaate the, jahan anek kothiyan tatha rasoiyan chalti thin. Aise sansthan sanyasiyon ke bharan-poshan tatha unke aahar ka pura bandobast rakhte the; isliye unke paas kheti wali zameen tatha gaushale bhi hoti thin. Yah baat dikhati hai ki us daur me math tatha sadhu-sansthaon ka gaon ki zameen tatha arthavyavastha par bhi bharpur asar tha. Exam point: Morera me eenton ki badi imarat Math kehlati thi tatha woh sanyasiyon ka nivas thi; unke paas kai bade mitti ke ghar bhi the; aise math tatha akhade khadi zameen tatha gaushala ke saath apna aarthik bandobast chalate the.

qe: When the surveyor's men were sent to look for rock crystal near Buduya, they were at first frightened away by whom?
qh: बुडुया के निकट फत्तिक ढूँढने भेजे गए सर्वेक्षक के आदमियों को सबसे पहले किसने डरा कर भगाया?
oe: The owners of the quarry and their traders
oh: खान के मालिक तथा उनके व्यापारी
e: Gaya kshetra me phatik yaani rock crystal dhoondhna aasan kaam nahi tha. Jab sarvekshak ke aadmi Buduya ke paas ki do pahadiyon par phatik dhoondhne bheje gaye, to unke saath bheja gaya vyapari unhe galat jagahon par le gaya tatha unhe dara-dhamka kar bhaga diya. Khan ke maalik tatha unse jude vyapari aise sthal ka pata bahar wale ko nahi dete the, kyunki unka poora munafa isi baat par tika tha ki khan ka asli sthal gupt rahe. Kuch samay baad jab sarvekshak ne das rupe mahine ke kharch ka zikr kiya tatha maalik par dabav dala, tab ek vyapari ne khud bataya ki phatik ka sthal asal me Buduya se kuch door, pahadiyon ke beech hai. Is tarah vyaparik munaafe ke kaaran khanon ki jaankari gupt rakhi jaati thi. Exam point: phatik ki khan ki jaankari khane ke maalik tatha unke vyapari gupt rakhte the tatha sarvekshak ke aadmiyon ko darate tatha galat jagah le jaate the; dabav padne par hi ek vyapari ne bataya ki asli sthal Buduya se kuch door pahadiyon me hai.
